AmbDescription:
Little Bennett Regional Park-Horse Trailer Parking Area. 
This is meetup is rescheduled from May 10th, 2026.
The time will be 9:00 AM due to the warmer weather.
Little Bennett Regional Park is located in the northern part of Montgomery County, near the Frederick County border, about 33 miles north of Baltimore.

We will be doing the Sidewinder Trail and dark Branch Loop, which is approximately 4 miles in length.  
This meetup is BEGINNER FRIENDLY, however everyone should be aware of their own and their dog's physical and mental fitness level and call it, if those levels are reached before the loop is completed.

For those of you who leave the trail loop while there are still teams out on the trail, please wait for everyone to finish, at the parking lot, if at all possible.  We want to make sure that everyone is accounted for and has returned safely.

Don't forget to bring water and snacks for you and your dog.  If you are not a member of North American Canicross, you will need to fo fill out a waiver form.

If would be nice to get feedback from those of you who plan on attending, so we can have an idea of how many participants to expect.
There will be a couple of different styles/brands of dog harnesses (;large breed only) for anyone who is looking, to try for size.  I also have 2 different styles of waistbelts for you to try as well.

In the future we will be having meetups at different trails in and around the Baltimore/Carroll/Howard/Montgomery County regions.  Some will be closer to"you" than others.  We strive to pick parks that have interesting, spacious trails, which are will marked, with elevation and footing variations and are at least 3 miles.  We will go to trails that have water access for the dogs in the warmer months  All trails are canicross-approved footing (e.g. unpaved).

AmbDescription:
Come join us for our weekly Canicross group run on Thursday evenings at the Old Reedy Creek Road Trailhead!

All fitness levels are welcome, and we generally run an out-and back route, so whether you're a seasoned runner or just starting out, you'll have a blast running or hiking with your four-legged friend.

\*depending on weather we may use multiuse trail into Umstead (wide double track trails) or the lake trail into Lake Crabtree County Park (single track trails).

What you need to know:

-As a general rule, please respect all dogs' space during canicross, and absolutely no on-leash, nose to nose greetings. This is not an event for dogs to be social with others, please keep space between your dog and the dog in front of you, and announce if you're going to be passing. This is a reactive dog friendly group.

-Gear: A Waist belt, bungee leash, and y-front harness are all you need to get started. We have plenty of extra belts/bungee lines/harnesses to try, and can help with fitting equipment too!

-We are not the fastest/slowest group out there, and all speeds are welcome (even those who need to hike)! If we are on the singletrack trails, we ensure no one is dropped. However, as the double track trail is a straight gravel road out and back, I cannot not guarantee someone will always be with you, but we do ensure everyone makes it back to the parking lot 🙂

We cancel for thunderstorms and extreme heat
